title: Operationalizing Pluralistic Values in Large Language Model Alignment Reveals Trade-offs in Safety, Inclusivity, and Model Behavior
reasoning: The paper investigates the alignment of LLMs with pluralistic human and moral values. It explicitly discusses ethical challenges in AI safety, the inclusion of underrepresented worldviews, and evaluates models across dimensions like toxicity, stereotypical bias, and emotional awareness, which are central to AI ethics.
